appearances.snippet: OK, so we already showed you Erika. She had a friend who was in the theater. Okay. Rob McCoy, he lost two congregants in the Thousand Oaks shooting at the Borderline Bar in 2018. And then he subsequently became the mayor and very close with the victim's family.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms Rob McCoy led a vigil and had a community role after the Borderline shooting. It contradicts the claim that he subsequently became mayor: he was already Thousand Oaks mayor at the time. The two congregants and claimed closeness to all victims' families were not independently established.
